description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2, WENO A 211 4): uniform flow in a channel three cells wide between banks of dry cells 6 m above the bed (geo.dat). The middle cell takes the central WENO stencil (both outer stencils hold a dry cell): level across the channel, normal depth. With the WENO-Z weights the linear stencil ran across both banks: lateral level differences of 0.3 m, no steady state.
